# An invented media_meta

Four transcripts (two days in September, two in October 2026), one Dropbox conflict copy (`C5900.MP4 2.json`, which
the index must skip), one fake proxy (18 bytes, not a video), invented frame embeddings, names, prints and a sync
map, and the markers. Every clip name, line, person and vector is invented.

`test/golden/` is what the CLI prints for it. To add a case, add a file here and a step to the goldens, and say in
the commit how the expected output was made. Never copy anything from a real `media_meta` here.
